observations: Three photos show a used diesel engine with red-painted components and silver/grey metal parts.
The engine has visible wear, grime, and some rust, especially on the red-painted sections.
The engine block has a long cylinder head with multiple ports and bolts, typical of a 4-cylinder diesel engine.
There is a red-painted intake manifold and a red-painted valve cover or part in photo 1 and 2.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the engine block or components in any photo.
The engine appears to be a heavy-duty diesel, likely for a truck or similar vehicle.
The seller claims it is an Iveco Eurocargo engine, but no such branding is visible in the photos.

claims.claim: The Iveco Eurocargo is primarily powered by Tector 5 and Tector 7 diesel engines
claims.evidence: No visible branding or model identifiers in any photo to confirm the engine is from an Iveco Eurocargo. The seller's claim cannot be verified from the images.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The engine may not be from an Iveco Eurocargo or may be a different model or brand.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block or cylinder head showing the brand and model number, or a photo of the engine installed in a vehicle with visible branding.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used diesel engine, not as an Iveco Eurocargo, which would reduce value.

risks.risk: The engine may be damaged or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the engine running, or a close-up of the oil pan, cylinder head, and internal components to check for cracks, wear, or damage.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or in unknown condition, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The engine may have been salvaged from a wrecked or accident-damaged vehicle.
risks.proof: A photo of the vehicle or engine's VIN plate, or a photo of the engine's serial number and any damage markings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a salvaged engine, which reduces value due to unknown history.

proof_requests: Close-up of the engine or gearbox code: the plate, sticker or number stamped on the block or case.
A clear photo of the engine block or cylinder head showing the brand and model number.
A video or photo of the engine running, or a close-up of the oil pan and internal components.
A photo of the vehicle or engine's VIN plate or serial number.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
